messages.author: 5b3ce66158457e97
messages.subject: phospho multiplicity+phosphorylation occupancy+DIA-NN output
parts:
Hi All,

I have analysed my phospho DIA data using directDIA, Spectronaut (library-free approach) and would like to perform downstream analysis. 

Using the currently available version of MSStatsPTM will I be able to perform the following:
1. PTM analysis of data with phospho multiplicity (2 and 3)?
2. Will I be able to determine the phosphorylation occupancy?

If not, when will that be possible?

Can we also use DIA-NN output into MSstats.

Thanks and regards,
Ashok

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: phospho multiplicity+phosphorylation occupancy+DIA-NN output
parts:
Hi Ashok,

MSstatsPTM will group peptides with multiple modifications together and perform differential analysis on them separately from the singly modified peptides. 

Currently we do not have any functionality to determine occupancy rates and do not have plans to implement it at this time (although we have discussed how to perform this calculation).

There is a DIA-NN converter available for MSstats but not MSstatsPTM. I actually have not yet seen any PTM data from DIA-NN, so if you have any you could share I can use it to build the MSstatsPTM converter.

Best,
Devon
